architecture: Three banks of four bridges. Each bank uses one TMUX1109 for both signal polarities and one for excitation plus Kelvin reference selection. All six parts use 3.3 V; exactly one bank is enabled. ADS1220 AIN0/AIN1 and REFP0/REFN0 remain fixed, with common ground.
mux_parameter_basis: 9.75 ohm is the -40 to 125 C specified maximum at 3.3 V. The signed bus leakage scenario sums one on drain and two disabled drains using the 25 C +/-0.1 nA characterized limits; signs are assumed. Supply current and capacitances are typical, not upper bounds.
adc_current_basis: A declared room-temperature constant-current scenario motivated by ADS1220 Fig. 6-16 near 1.25 V, not digitized data or a guaranteed bound. Reference uses the 10 nA typical input current plus 0.3 nA selected/shared-bus leakage. Actual current depends on pin voltage and temperature.
series_resistor_reason: Each excitation/reference path includes 47 ohm to limit a 2.5 V capacitor connection step to at most 53.2 mA before switch resistance, within the TMUX1109 60 mA continuous rating at Tj=125 C. Kelvin sensing occurs after the excitation resistor and switch.
timing_basis: Declared board/cable/filter and SPI schedule. Disable all banks, set address, enable only its bank, settle, START/SYNC, wait DRDY, RDATA plus 24 bits, disable. Bridge remains excited until read completes. ADC active-current subtotal is conservatively applied throughout the scan. No RF exchange occurs during acquisition.
reference_policy: Calibrate each installed channel once in ratio units, and retain a separately identified loaded mechanical reference. Receiver keeps coefficients and the 12 reference codes under that identity. Neither power cycling nor a new snapshot re-zeroes the structure.
noise_basis: The old 90/180 nV short-input noise is reused only as a conditional input-noise scale. ADS1220 Table 7-1 uses the internal reference; external-reference/filter/board noise has not been measured.
storage_basis: 5.0 to 4.5 V reservoir. Report ideal energy conversion and linear-regulator pass-charge requirements separately. Controller, RF exchange/retries, regulator quiescence/startup and storage leakage need their own measured or component-derived charge; no assumed harvesting power. Rail capacitor cold-start charge is included separately.
